title: Right to left, dp[c − w] still holds the previous item's row, so an item can't be taken twice
caption: Adding item w2 p10 to the one-row table. The shaded cells have already been updated for this item.

frames.text: Before item w2 p10: dp holds row 1 (only item 1), [0, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6]. Walk c from 5 down to w = 2.
c = 5: max(6, dp[3] + 10) = 16. dp[3] is still the old 6, from the previous item's row.
c = 4: max(6, dp[2] + 10) = 16. dp[2] has not been touched yet for this item.
c = 2: max(6, dp[0] + 10) = 10. Done: [0, 6, 10, 16, 16, 16]. Every read was to the left of every write, so item 2 was used at most once.
